item.title: 🟠 Troubleshoot Hyper-V guarded fabrics and shielded VMs
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and watch for suspicious sign-ins.

Use this FAQ when a guarded fabric can't be deployed, a host can't attest, a shielded virtual machine (VM) can't be provisioned or started, or an operation such as migration, servicing, or recovery fails. It accompanies the Microsoft Learn module: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/guarded-fabric-shielded-virtual-machines/

 

Warning

Don't use TPM clearing, an unrelated new or local KP, disabled Secure Boot or CI, a weaker attestation mode, certificate-validation bypasses, or copied owner private keys as generic troubleshooting fixes. Don't delete protected VM state or checkpoint files to make an error disappear. These actions can weaken the trust boundary or permanently remove access to encrypted data.
